title: Near-Optimal Mixedness Testing with Pauli Measurements
summary: We consider a fundamental problem of \emph{mixedness testing}: Given $n$ copies of an $N$-qubit state $ρ$, determine whether $ρ= \mathbb{I}_d/d$ or $\|ρ-\mathbb{I}_d/d\|_1 \geq \varepsilon$ with high probability, where $d = 2^N$. In particular, we focus on performing this task in the practical setting of single-qubit measurements, where measurements are prepared independently on each qubit. We provide a nearly complete picture of single-qubit mixedness tesing by showing $n = \tildeΘ\left(\sqrt{10}^N/\varepsilon^2\right)$.
